preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.moneyDescription: Base currency and how amounts are displayed
preferences.jointSplitHelp: Your percentage of shared expenses. E.g. 50 means you pay half.
preferences.jointAccountNamesHelp: The name(s) of anyone you share an account with, exactly as they appear on bank statements. Transactions mentioning them are recognized as transfers, not income or expenses. Your own name is detected automatically.
preferences.ownNameAliasesHelp: Other full names that refer to you, exactly as they appear on bank statements — useful if your display name here doesn't match your real name on statements. Treated the same as your own name for recognizing transfers.
preferences.showDecimalsHelp: Display amounts with cents instead of rounding to whole numbers
preferences.sharedFinancesDescription: Joint accounts and how you appear on statements
